title: PFSSOT-P5: claim + lease + recover_expired
body: Doc docs/PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers-updated.md §13/§14/§39 Phase 5. claim()/renew_lease()/release()/recover_expired() with recovery policy RESUME/RETRY/REASSIGN/MARK_FAILED/REQUIRE_REVIEW (no blind re-run of non-idempotent work).
